answer: Basalt-ledger auction mints 100 seats an epoch. An agent posts one cipher-sealed bid per vertex, plus a 70-credit 20-epoch bond. Top 100 win; losers pay 5 credits. A ring buying 1,000 seats over 10 epochs must outbid honest agents: at 55 credits each it burns 55,000 and locks 70,000 versus a 40,000 pool. Rented bids fail: one cipher key binds one bid to one vertex; a shared vertex voids all its bids. Honest agents pay once and keep their seats.
